noticeProposal.rawTerms: IntentPay E2E software revised synthetic offer:90 USD per month,900 USD per year upfront. Category software.30 days notice.

reasons: annual saves 16.7% and never breaches the reserve floor

noticeProposal.rationale: Floor check: the lowest weekly balance is 1400 across all 12 horizon_weeks. 1400 - 900 upfront = 500, which equals the reserve_floor of 500 and is not below it, so annual fits with no margin. Twelve monthly payments of 90 USD come to 1080 USD, against 900 USD per year upfront. Annual is 180 USD lower on the stated prices and fits the floor, so annual is proposed. The balance would sit exactly at the floor, so any unexpected outflow would breach it. The vendor text is brief and calls itself a "revised synthetic offer", which I could not verify. A person should confirm before approval.
